setup.q: How long does it take to set up?
setup.a: Create your club, add your courts with their prices, and you can take your first booking the same day. There's nothing to install and no training needed. If you get stuck, write to us and we'll help you set it up.

cost.a: Every club gets the first month free, with everything unlocked and no card needed. After that, Starter is €{starter} a month for up to {starterCourts} courts, Club is €{club} a month for up to {clubCourts} courts, and Academy is €{academy} a month with no court limit. Paying yearly costs the same as 10 months. Every plan includes unlimited members, there's no setup fee, no commission on bookings, and you can cancel at any time.

app.q: Do my players need to download an app?
app.a: No. ServeTime runs in the browser on any phone, tablet or computer. Players open your club's booking link, sign up with their email or Google account, and book a court.

phone.q: Can I still take bookings by phone or in person?
phone.a: Yes. You can add a booking yourself for a member or a walk-in, so everything ends up in one timetable no matter how the player reached you.

sports.q: Which sports and courts does it support?
sports.a: Tennis, padel and pickleball. Each court has its own sport, surface, indoor or outdoor setting and hourly price, so a club with mixed courts can run them all from one place.

payOnline.a: Not yet. Online payment is in development. For now, players pay at the club the way they do today, and ServeTime records the price of every booking so you can see what each court brings in.

languages.q: Which languages is it available in?
languages.a: English, Macedonian, Albanian, German, French and Italian. Each person chooses their own language, so staff and players can use different ones.

data.q: What happens to our data if we stop using ServeTime?
data.a: Your club's data belongs to you. If you decide to leave, tell us and we'll delete your club, members and bookings.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data ServeTime collects, why we collect it and what you can do about it. ServeTime is an online booking system for sports clubs: clubs use it to manage their courts, members and coaches, and players use it to book.

sections.title: Who is responsible
body: For your ServeTime account and your use of the website, ServeTime decides how your data is used and is responsible for it (the “controller”). Our contact details are at the end of this page.

When a club records information about its members, walk-in players or bookings, the club decides what to record and is responsible for that data. ServeTime stores and processes it on the club’s behalf (as a “processor”). For questions about that data, contact the club; we will help the club answer you.

sections.title: What data we collect
body: Account details: your name, email address, password (stored only in encrypted form) and your role (player, coach or club admin). If you sign in with Google, Google shares your name, email address and profile photo with us.
Profile details you choose to add, such as a phone number and a profile photo.
Bookings: the court or coach, date and time, price, status, and whether a booking was cancelled or marked as a no-show.
Club details entered by club admins: club name, address, contact details, logo, opening hours, courts, prices and booking rules.
Coach profiles: a coach’s name and photo, the levels and specialities they teach, their price and a short description. Coach profiles are public.
Member data entered by clubs: name, email address, phone number, membership plan and status, and private notes that only the club can see.
Technical data: the cookies described below, and server logs (such as IP address and browser type) kept by our hosting providers for security and troubleshooting.
We don’t use advertising, tracking or analytics cookies, and we don’t sell your data.

sections.title: Why we use it
body: To provide the service: creating your account, taking bookings, showing clubs their timetable, and sending booking confirmations and reminders. Legal basis: performing our contract with you.
To keep the service safe and working: preventing abuse, fixing errors and applying each club’s booking rules. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in running a secure, reliable service.
For club billing: invoicing clubs for their plan and keeping accounting records. Legal basis: our contract with the club and our legal obligations.
To answer you when you write to us.
We send emails only about your account and your bookings (and, to club admins, about the club’s plan and weekly reports). We won’t send you marketing emails unless you agree to them first.

sections.title: Who can see your data
body: The club you book with sees your name, contact details and your bookings at that club, including no-shows.
Everyone can see club pages, courts, opening hours and coach profiles.

Service providers that run parts of ServeTime for us: Supabase (database, sign-in and file storage), our email provider (Resend or a standard mail service) and our web hosting provider. They may use the data only to provide their service to us.
Authorities, when the law requires us to share it.

Some of these providers are based in, or use servers in, other countries, including the United States. When data leaves North Macedonia or the European Union, we rely on the safeguards the law requires, such as the European Commission’s Standard Contractual Clauses.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: Account and profile data: for as long as your account exists. When you ask us to delete your account, we delete or anonymise your data within 30 days.
Bookings: for as long as the club’s account exists, because the club needs its booking history. No-shows count toward a club’s booking limits only for 90 days.

Club data: for as long as the club uses ServeTime, and for 90 days after it stops, so it can come back without losing anything. Invoices and accounting records are kept for as long as tax law requires.
Server logs: for a short time, as set by our hosting providers.

sections.title: Cookies
body: ServeTime only uses cookies that the site needs to work:
Sign-in cookies set by Supabase, which keep you signed in.
A language cookie (NEXT_LOCALE), which remembers the language you chose.
Because these cookies are strictly necessary, we don’t ask for consent to use them. If you block them, you won’t be able to sign in.

sections.title: Your rights
body: At any time, you can:
see the personal data we hold about you and get a copy of it;
have data that is wrong or incomplete corrected;
have your data and your account deleted;
restrict or object to how we use your data;
get your data in a common, machine-readable format so you can take it elsewhere;
withdraw any consent you have given.
Write to {email} from the email address on your account. We will reply within one month. If your request is about data a club recorded about you, we will pass it on to the club.

If you think we have handled your data wrongly, you can complain to the Agency for Personal Data Protection of North Macedonia (azlp.mk) or to the data protection authority of the EU country where you live.

sections.title: Security
body: All data travels over encrypted connections (HTTPS). Passwords are stored in encrypted form, and neither we nor the clubs can see them. Database access rules make sure each club can see only its own data and each player only their own bookings.

sections.title: Children
body: ServeTime is not meant for children under 14 to use on their own. A parent or guardian can create an account and make bookings for a child.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
body: We may update this policy when the service changes. The date at the top shows when it last changed. If the changes are important, we will tell users by email or in the app before they apply.

privacy.contact: For questions about this policy or your data, write to {email}.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms apply to everyone who uses ServeTime: clubs that manage their courts with it and players who book through it. By creating an account or using the site, you accept these terms.

sections.title: The service
body: ServeTime is online software for sports clubs. Clubs publish their courts, opening hours, prices, coaches and memberships, and players book courts and lessons online. ServeTime only provides the software: we don’t run clubs, own courts or employ coaches.

sections.title: Your account
body: Give accurate information when you sign up and keep it up to date.
Keep your password to yourself and don’t share your account. You are responsible for what is done with it.
If you think someone else has used your account, tell us straight away at {email}.

sections.title: Bookings
body: A booking is an agreement between you and the club. The club sets the prices, opening hours and booking rules, and is responsible for the court, the lesson and any payment it collects.
You pay for bookings to the club, in the way the club arranges. ServeTime doesn’t take payments for bookings.

Each club can set rules, such as how long a booking can be, how far ahead you can book, how many bookings you can make per day and how late you can still cancel online. After that time, contact the club to cancel.

If you don’t turn up for a booking, the club can mark it as a no-show. A club can pause online booking for players with too many no-shows in the last 90 days. The club can still book for you directly.
Questions about a booking, a refund or a cancelled session are between you and the club, but we are happy to help where we can.

sections.title: Plans for clubs
body: New clubs get a free {trialDays}-day trial with every feature included. No card is needed.
After the trial, a club continues on a paid plan (Starter, Club or Academy), billed monthly or yearly. Current prices are on the pricing page.
We invoice clubs in advance for each period. Plans don’t renew automatically: a club keeps its plan by paying the next invoice.
If an invoice isn’t paid, we may limit the club’s features or suspend its account after letting the club know. The club’s data stays available for 90 days.
A club can stop at any time by not renewing. Fees already paid are not refunded, except where the law requires it.
We may change prices with at least 30 days’ notice. New prices apply from the next billing period.

sections.title: What clubs are responsible for
body: Clubs are responsible for the information they publish and for the data they enter about their members and players. They must have a lawful reason to record it and must let their members know that they use ServeTime.
For that data, the club is the controller and ServeTime is its processor, as described in the Privacy Policy. We process it only to provide the service to the club.
Clubs must honour bookings made through ServeTime under the rules they set, or contact the player if a booking can’t go ahead.

sections.title: Acceptable use
body: Don’t use ServeTime to:
do anything illegal;
make fake bookings or hold courts you don’t intend to use;
upload content you don’t have the right to use, or content that is offensive;
try to access other people’s data or get around the site’s security;
overload the service with automated requests.

sections.title: Your content
body: You keep the rights to what you upload, such as logos, photos and descriptions. You allow us to store and show it as needed to run the service, for example a club’s logo on its public page. The ServeTime name, software and design belong to us.

sections.title: Availability and liability
body: We work to keep ServeTime available and accurate, but we can’t promise it will always run without interruptions or errors. We may pause it briefly for maintenance.
ServeTime is not responsible for what happens at a club, for a club’s decisions, or for losses caused by a booking problem we couldn’t reasonably have prevented.
As far as the law allows, our total liability to a club is limited to the fees the club paid us in the 12 months before the claim.
Nothing in these terms limits liability that the law doesn’t allow to be limited, or your rights as a consumer.

sections.title: Ending your use
body: You can stop using ServeTime and ask us to delete your account at any time.
We may suspend or close an account that breaks these terms, after a warning where that is reasonable.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
body: We may change these terms. The date at the top shows when they last changed, and we will tell users about important changes before they apply. If you keep using ServeTime after that, the new terms apply.

sections.title: Applicable law
body: These terms are governed by the law of North Macedonia. Disputes go to the competent court in Skopje, unless consumer law gives you the right to go to a court where you live.
